summary:
VERIFICATION DID NOT RUN: no claim was independently confirmed or contradicted. All three of my WebSearch calls (IRAS/MOF caps, Budget 2026 SRS changes, MOM retirement age) were refused because the turn's shared web-search budget (200 calls) was already used up. Direct fetches of www.ocbc.com, www.uob.com.sg and www.dbs.com.sg failed DNS (hosts outside the session's allowed network domains), *.gov.sg was already known to be blocked, and the repo holds no saved source material. To finish this check, send a follow-up message or raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION; the bank hosts would also need allowing in network settings.

Result: 34 of 35 facts are "unverifiable" and 1 is "partially_correct". Treat every SRS fact as unverified, not as passed.

What I could do without sources:
- Arithmetic: all six worked examples are internally correct (details in example_checks).
- Scope defect: srs-retirement-age-63-before-1-jul-2026 says every first contribution before 1 Jul 2026 locks in age 63. The researcher's own notes cite 62 for older accounts, so the claim needs a lower bound (63 only for 1 Jul 2022 to 30 Jun 2026; 62 before that). Those dates come from the task brief and my recall, not from a search.
- Recall check (not evidence): none of the 35 claims conflicts with what I know of the SRS rules. The caps also match the regulation formula as I recall it: 15% and 35% of 17 x S$6,000 give S$15,300 and S$35,700.
- Overstated confidence: several "high" facts rest on search-result paraphrases or inference, not page text - srs-relief-non-resident, srs-withholding-tax-foreigners-prs, srs-contributions-stop-after-first-withdrawal, srs-cap-unchanged-since-2016, srs-eligibility.

Re-verify first (these drive the v1 calculator per /home/user/jungle-pest-sales/sg-tax-optimiser/SPEC.md):
1. Caps of S$15,300 / S$35,700 for calendar 2026, and that Budget 2025 and Budget 2026 changed nothing. The Budget statements and annexes were never checked by anyone.
2. The S$80,000 overall relief cap and the no-refund rule.
3. Relief timing: 2026 contributions give YA2027 relief, tax residents only, deadline 31 Dec 2026. Bank cut-off times are still unsourced, so the calculator should not state one.
4. Retirement age of 64 from 1 Jul 2026, and the 62/63 history.

Do not implement yet:
- Pro-rating of the cap in the year a foreigner becomes a PR (single secondary paraphrase, no formula).
- The 15% concessionary rate for non-resident withdrawals (unclear whether it is a withholding or final rate).
- The reduction formula for the S$400,000 death/terminal-illness exemption.
- The secondary-source claim that the cap halves to S$7,650 from age 66: I know of no such rule and it conflicts with the flat caps; treat it as false unless an official source appears.

No open question was resolved. The four missed_facts are labelled UNVERIFIED and come from my recall, with no source opened; they are leads to check, not facts to ship.
